name: IKHCO | White Truffle | Live Rosin | 1g
description:
Cross Strain: Gorilla Glue #4 x Peanut Butter Breath

Dive into decadence with White Truffle, a 1g puck of pure, solventless live rosin. Expertly extracted to preserve the full spectrum of the flower, this rosin delivers rich, earthy, and subtly sweet notes reminiscent of its luxurious namesake.

Smooth, flavorful, and potent, White Truffle offers a balanced, euphoric experience that highlights the strain’s nuanced character. Handcrafted for connoisseurs, each dab melts effortlessly, providing a clean, flavorful, and elevated session.
